item.title: Many Democrats are still down on the Democratic Party, a new AP-NORC poll finds
item.description: Only about 7 in 10 Democrats have a positive view of the Democratic Party, according to new polling from The Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research. While the overwhelming majority of Democrats still feel good about their party, they're much less positive than they've been in the past.

item.title: Girls Swimming: Smoky Hill’s Lyla Bailey leads way in 5A diving competition with seventh-place finish
item.description: Junior Lyla Bailey became Smoky Hill's first diving finalist at the Class 5A state meet since 2019 and parlayed it into a seventh-place finish Wednesday at the Veterans' Memorial Aquatic Center.
